title: Area of rectilinear shapes
summary: Year 7: split and add, find missing lengths, compare removing cut-outs, and practise on a scaffolded authored worksheet.

els.text: Find the area of a rectilinear shape and explain your method.

•  Split into rectangles and add their areas
•  Find a missing length before calculating area
•  Compare splitting with removing a cut-out
A 2D shape with straight sides meeting at right angles. Its area is the amount of surface it covers, measured in square units.

items.title: Explain why we add rectangle areas when splitting, but subtract the cut-out area when using the whole rectangle
question: Explain why we add rectangle areas when splitting, but subtract the cut-out area when using the whole rectangle.
answer: Splitting covers the shape exactly once. The enclosing rectangle includes an extra cut-out, so remove its area. Give area in cm².
